caption: The drawing features a single object, a weather vane in the shape of a cow, positioned centrally against a plain, off-white or cream-colored background. The weather vane is rendered in tones of rusted brown, orange, and earthy hues, giving it a mottled, aged texture. The cow is depicted in profile view, facing left, with two prominent upward-curving horns, visible eyes, and an udder. The tail is bent back and appears looped around the rear leg. The cow stands with all four legs visible, aligned on a horizontal bar, which is attached to a vertical pole below for mounting. The composition is uncluttered, with the cow and its support structure as the only elements present, and there are no additional decorations or markings on the background.
title: Cow Weather Vane
